options.label: FP8
options.note: Kijai's fp8_scaled, 6.2 GB. Same layout as BF16, small parts shift a little. No faster on an RTX 5080.

options.label: int8
options.note: Comfy-Org's int8_convrot, 6.2 GB. The closest copy of BF16, in about half the time.

options.label: NVFP4
options.note: Comfy-Org's nvfp4, 4.5 GB. The fastest and smallest, and it drifts furthest from BF16.
